info.title: Stage CMS API
info.description: Humans and agents share the same content operations. All creates are drafts. Reads require a token. Publishing is explicit. Never retry a stale write with a fresh version without reconciling content.

get.description: Required permission: content:read. Returns summaries without body or named fields unless include=body is requested. next_page is null when no further item exists; concurrent writes can move items between requests. The published filter selects latest drafts of pages with a live revision; use /api/pages/{id}/published for live content.

next_page.description: Next page number, or null when no more items existed at the time of the query.

parameters.name: include
parameters.description: Omit for summaries. Use body to include Markdown and named fields in every result.

get.description: Required permission: content:read. Returns up to 50 images. q searches names and descriptions. Follow next_page until null.

get.description: Requires content:read. Read definitions before writing structured pages. Theme selection is owner-only in Settings.

get.summary: Read the published revision by page ID
get.description: Requires content:read. Returns the exact live revision, not a later draft; 404 when unpublished or archived. Read the latest draft before writing.
Requires content:read. Current summaries include this page and all linked language versions, including archived pages.

post.description: Requires content:read and content:write. Copies the current saved source into a separate private draft; does not translate text or publish. Source version must match. One page per locale in each group, including archive. Writes are not idempotent; inspect translations after a lost response.
